domestic_evidence: No GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tender award or annual-report domestic/export split could be retrieved: thecompanycheck.com returned HTTP 403, eximpedia.app returned HTTP 403, volza.com returned HTTP 403, and web_search was unavailable (searx connection refused) for all queries. Domestic supply therefore not verified — null, not inferred from the export records.
note: Real, dated, named-buyer export shipments are confirmed from Indian customs bills of lading, so this is not a website claim: talc/steatite powder (HS 25262000) and aluminium sulphate (HS 28332210) moving out of KANAKPURA ICD and CHENNAI SEA to Malaysia, DRC, Kenya, UAE and Pakistan, latest 2026-02-28. Declared HS set (251741; 251820; 252620; 252910) is partly consistent — 252620 matches the dominant observed code; 251741/251820/252910 were not seen in the rows read, and an additional code 28332210 (aluminium sulphate) and an import row under 38249900 (coated calcium carbonate, supplier ALPHA STONE FOR GRINDING AND PACKING, Egypt → HAZIRA) appear, so the company also imports. Per project rules this is not a rejection ground; actual codes should be recorded as 25262000 + 28332210 (export) and 38249900 (import). Address on record: 146/2 Old China Bazar Street, 5th Floor, Kolkata-700001, consistent with the claimed West Bengal state. Legal owner 'SANDEEP BAID' could not be verified — no registry access (403s), so left unconfirmed rather than asserted. Role looks like manufacturer_trader (own talc/steatite powder grades plus traded aluminium sulphate and imported calcium carbonate), but that is an inference from product mix, not a registry fact. Domestic supply side is a genuine gap, not a negative finding: 'unknown', not 'none_found'.
